payload.title: Separate train-only structural diagnostics from deployable evidence
payload.decision: Treat E003's 10.9280 surface-assisted result as validated OOF understanding but not a competition-deployable candidate. Retain E004 geometry-plus-prefix only as a weak packaged fallback and move the primary queue to test-available GR/typewell PF and trellis paths.
payload.rationale: All six formation-surface columns are absent from test horizontal files. Removing them reduces the best coefficient model to 15.4913 RMSE. GR/typewell summary ablations do not improve the geometry-prefix core, so explicit alignment/state candidates are the next falsifiable route.
payload.revisit_trigger: The official test schema changes, the missing surfaces are legally supplied through a verified competition input, or an explicit test-available model reconstructs equivalent evidence.
